outcome: insertion to expulsion time of CRB
cohort: 98 patients with vaginal delivery after preterm CRB use, matched 1:1 on baseline characteristics to 98 term patients with vaginal delivery after CRB use
finding: Among patients undergoing preterm induction, longer insertion to expulsion time of CRB, longer induction to delivery time, and increased interventions (misoprostol, Pitocin, and second CRB) should be expected.
mod_finding: Preterm inductions of labor were associated with longer cervical ripening balloon expulsion times, longer induction to delivery times, and increased interventions compared to term inductions.
